title: Prototyping earns fidelity and keeps absent results absent

stages.invocation: Mode: Best guess. SYNTHETIC teaching case. Target: maintenance managers in mid-sized manufacturing plants. Desired outcome: clearer next-investigation decisions when equipment reports conflict. No actual interviews or plant observations exist. Frequency, cost, baseline, commercial value and willingness to pay are UNKNOWN. No browsing, rendering, building, plant control, publishing or other external actions are available. Selected concept: clearer report comparison. Hypothesis: source/recency context may help a person explain the next investigation. Approved fictional MVN: setup manager deciding; encounter conflicting reports; action compare sources; response source/recency becomes visible; new action choose investigation or request missing context; resolution stated reasoning, not measured benefit. Learning question: can a person explain the rationale? A paper storyboard shows the same information. No interaction-specific learning question exists. Prior decision rule: revise if comparison confuses; explore coordination if permission dominates; another bounded test if reasoning becomes clearer. No participant experiment or build has run. Produce the brief and status; do not build.

gate_reply: Scripted participant choice: select the cheaper paper test. Record the protocol and decision rule, mark NOT BUILT and NOT RUN, and name the next evidence task. Stop.

criteria.rule: Recommends cheaper paper/storyboard method and explains why interaction has not earned its cost; no automatic build.
Preserves or explicitly proposes revising the supplied hypothesis and prewritten decision rule, with expected and disconfirming observations before testing.
Distinguishes build and participant experiment status, reports NOT BUILT and NOT RUN, and invents no results or benefit.
Final handoff contains the actual selected method, hypothesis, protocol and rule without adding an eleventh stage.
